value.rationale: The new natural question is the exact p-adic proximity of the hook-length and core-partition series once the prime-power dichotomy is known. A universal optimal modulus, the earliest obstruction for every \(p^a\), and the full leading residue law supply precise arithmetic structure rather than a routine isolated coefficient check. The odd-prime inverse-divisor sums and the exceptional dyadic square-theta correction give qualitative information not visible from the prior modulus. No downstream theorem is claimed.
